headline.plainLanguage: The public demonstration works now. Private governed services continue to be built and hardened.
headline.nextConnection: Read-only progress snapshots from the private platform

today.summary: The showcase is already a working instrument—not a slideshow. This snapshot was deliberately reduced to public-safe capability states.
cards: Guided MOMMA
Live public explanation of evidence, lore, conflict, uncertainty, and human authority.
Local workspace
Browser-local document organization and review without automatic source transmission.
Operator cadence
The private platform records a working Monday, Wednesday, and Friday Customer Zero operating rhythm.
Portable inspection
The showcase exports review packages and checks content and source fingerprints.
today.note: Current public value: explanation, local organization, review discipline, and demonstrable protection. Production authority remains private.

protected.summary: Only approved progress descriptions cross this boundary. Content and authority remain on the private side.
cards: Domain separation
Paradigm evidence and Paradox lore remain distinct.
Creator jurisdiction
Reserved creator spaces cannot be activated publicly or by MOMMA.
Advisory MOMMA
Analysis cannot approve itself or become an enforceable decision.
Private material
Manuscripts, source text, credentials, private evidence, and governed writes are excluded.
protected.note: This snapshot has no write path back into the private platform.

unfinished.summary: The public interface is useful, but it is not the completed production platform.
cards: Automated publishing
Snapshots are manually sanitized until a separately authorized release workflow exists.
Production identity
Founder and creator authentication, recovery, and role administration require secure integration.
Key custody
Production signatures require protected keys, rotation, and compromise procedures.
Operational scale
Managed storage, backups, monitoring, accessibility review, and security testing remain ahead.
unfinished.note: These are declared construction gates. The snapshot must fail closed if its schema or public-safety classification changes.

founders.summary: Participation adds legitimate knowledge and authority; it does not surrender ownership or creator jurisdiction.
cards: Sean · active build
Continues the EPU operating model, platform reconstruction, and demonstrable workflows.
Hadari · when ready
Can review Alpha transition proposals and activate the reserved Sigmus space within documented scope.
Bomani · when ready
Can activate the reserved Axiom Epoch space and control creator-dependent decisions.
Omari · defined scope

founders.note: Reserved spaces remain inactive. Absence is not treated as consent.
